verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's API lets you programmatically create verification sessions and reusable Flows that can be used to verify 'any number of users,' and results can be retrieved/accessed programmatically via the API — enabling scripted, repeated (bulk-style) verification workflows. However, there is no documented batch/bulk API endpoint (e.g., bulk-create or bulk-list verification sessions) or explicit bulk-processing feature; each verification session is created and managed individually. Missing for 10: a dedicated batch/bulk API operation, evidence of bulk listing/exporting many verification results at once, and independent confirmation of large-scale automated batch usage.
